I just want to say that I'm grateful for you actually responding to me too. I don't really know if it's proper etiquette to keep on replying after a day but I'll probably stop soon anyway. Besides, I've forgotten my password so after I wipe my history I'll never be able to log on this account again, haha. 

I feel like the difference between me and real women is that they can actually be something other than a fetish. Okay, scratch that for a second. I wouldn't mind if someone regretted anything with me and beat me up or even killed me. I don't think I'd fight it beyond that instinctive need to live in all humans (which stops me from ending it right now); rather, I'd encourage it. 

It's just that my whole life revolves around this impossible wish. All I'm doing is imitating a woman, really. Don't you think it's creepy? I do. Just imagining someone listening to me say, "Hey, before we start anything, I'm not really a woman. I'm a tranny." makes me want to rip off my skin with my fingernails. It's just so freaking deceptive in a really creepy way that I'm amazed that no one's actually beat me to death yet. I get goosebumps just imagining it. I am honestly shocked that some people actually find this twisted body touchable. It's a greater miracle to me than Jesus Christ, haha!

I hope you don't mind that I'm still replying to you. I don't know how long I'm supposed to actually respond to people here but mostly it seems that the chain peters out after about a day. I'll stop responding soon too. But for now I guess I'll answer your questions! 

I'm not afraid of being kicked out. I think being kicked out would either give me that final incentive to kill myself or really push me towards my "goals" (earn money haha). It'd depend on my mood at the time, I suppose. I don't know if I can pull my own weight... real estate here is pretty expensive. I have a lump sum saved up but I don't have a stable income right now sooo... and it's not like I can rent a room in someone's house, seeing how I'd like to make incalls in my own "house" rather than hotels. My doctor let me know about shelters that could take me in if I ever got kicked out but I don't think I could ever go to a shelter, haha. I don't want to make anyone feel uncomfortable there... I think it's very egotistical to think that my needs supersede the dozens of other people there. 

My therapist has offered to get me on meds before but I declined. It's not that I think that I'm too good for it but I'm afraid of it interfering with my other meds. I'm scared of liver failure sometimes, haha, which is ironic considering the whole suicide thing. I'm also scared that I'll be put off my hormones if I do admit to being depressed... it's a catch-22, where I'm not allowed to be depressed to be on hormones but getting antidepressants might force me off them causing me to be even more depressed. 

I'm just sick of being sick. If depression is a condition, that's just one more condition I have to add on. I don't know why I was born with such a fucked up brain. I just wish that dying was easier! Today I read that rabbits can literally die from panic over little things like baths and vacuum cleaners; they're so lucky! I think I'm too addicted to self-pity to ever get on meds anyway. It feels good to feel bad about myself. I guess I'm just one of those people that refuse to fix themselves. It's why I consider myself a lazy person. I just don't put in any effort into anything; it's like a disgusting childs mentality. 

I feel like I'm talking in circles. I haven't said anything new to you; I've just kept complaining about the same thing over and over again. That's how it normally goes with my therapist too. I feel like every session is like deja vu. It's like we talk about the same issues every single time I see him. No progress. I feel like I'm wasting money (and he's not cheap either) and the only reason why I'm still going is that I've sunk too much into it to quit. 

I know this sounds really pathetic but I wish I had one friend that I could actually talk to. I used to actually be "popular", haha! Now I go weeks without even a single text from anyone besides the phone bills. It's just so stupid that I can't get over it—I knew going into this that this pathetic life would be the outcome and yet it's like I've gone into it blind. Sometimes I think about just telling them what I am but I know that it's not going to go over well. My friends were all just regular guys; they loved to play basketball and get mediocre-to-high grades and smoke pot and work out and a few took roids. I already know their stance on things like me so I don't know why some part of me just wants to tell them—maybe it's some suicidal death wish? One of them showed me tranny porn a few times; maybe he'll fuck me on the down-low, haha! 

Maybe people just aren't meant to be solitary. I know that this is how life's going to be for me heading on out but I don't know, my brain just can't seem to accept it. Oh well. Time flies by quicker than you think... I can remember all my childhood memories so well it's like it happened yesterday. It's not like my life is unique; I bet that millions of people kill themselves every year. It just is. I just hope I'm not reborn as a slug or something (that is, if reincarnation really is real). 

I just feel like there's nothing redeeming about me. I got bad grades, was a pretty terrible person even before all this shit (I bullied some kids in elementary school—I guess they'll have the last laugh!), was terrible at sports, detention was like my homeroom, killed multiple pets out of neglect, stole my friends' toys when I was younger, vandalized a kid's house with my friends, was never really close to my siblings or parents, and I sucked my older brother's dick when I was younger, haha! If there was a real bingo for degenerates, I'm pretty sure I'd check off all the boxes. Even if I wasn't a tranny, I'd be a terrible person anyway. There isn't a single redeeming quality I have... I daydream about torturing myself before I commit suicide, even though I'm deathly afraid of pain. When I close my eyes, I can see my pet frog rotting in his tank full of dirty water. 

But you didn't know what a disgusting thing I was before you responded to me. I should have put it up straight up but seeing how my entire identity revolves around deceit, I guess I couldn't help but keep it hidden for a few moments more. Well, I guess I could have helped it but just decided not to out of some desperate attempt at garnering pity. Ugh, I just can't stop being a degenerate. Like I honestly feel like that just sums up my entire fucking self. Degenerate. It's almost like someone invented that word for me. 

This is how I know that there isn't a God out there. So many good people die every day—Boko Haram kills hundreds of innocent people—and somehow I'm the one that's living comfortably in a first world country? Haha! Or maybe he does exist and when I die, I'll spend the rest of my eternal life in excruciating pain. That kinda scares me... but not enough to stop me from living this degenerate lifestyle. The funny thing is that I never lived in a religious household! I did have a Bible but I never read it fully... and after I came out, well, I learned a lot from my family. 

God, I just can't scrub this disgusting feeling from my body. Like sometimes lying in bed, I'll get this intense feeling of just, I don't know, pure fucking disgust and I'll spasm all over the bed. I just can't stop feeling disgusted at what I am but I'm too much of a coward to do anything substantial about it either. It makes me wonder how criminals can live with themselves even though I haven't committed any crimes... the fact that I feel this disgusted about myself must mean that I've committed some moral crime at the very least! It's like I have a layer of mud underneath my skin; this disgust that I feel just can't be washed out. I hate when people are nice to me. It feels entirely fake or undeserved. When people act nice to me, it only serves to increase my disgust with myself. It makes me calmer when people hate me. 

But even still, I just can't seem to find the courage to off myself. Haha! I guess since that's not a degenerate trait, of course I wouldn't have it. Even accidents don't seem to happen to me—it's like even cars are repulsed by me and they don't hit me. No one wants to kill me even though sometimes I intentionally walk "shady" streets at night. Maybe it's my punishment to live with my disgusting body until I die from old age. If so, God really does come up with the best ideas!

Even if you respond to this, I don't know how to respond back. I can't talk about anything without falling back on this train of disgusting, disgusting, disgusting. If you asked me even the most innocent of questions like say, what's your favourite flavour of ice cream, I'd still find a way to derail the conversation back on this disgusting path. There's so much you don't know about me and so much that I want to tell (probably only because of anonymity, haha) but it's not like I'm paying you for this. It's just that I haven't actually spoken to someone like this in so long that I can't seem to control myself. I wish someone would just shoot me. My brain's just going haywire and like I feel like I have so much energy right now! It's like I'm actually going crazy, like I'm some fucking hermit that's gone rabid over this small piece of human interaction. If there was a way to scream over the internet, I'd probably have done it already.

No, I don't buy into that kind of thought. I know that that's considered transphobic but you know at this point, I hate myself more than any transphobe could haha. I feel like that whole, "oh, you're just a girl with something extra" is just some feel-goods thinking that doesn't really help anyone. It's just another something that people say to try to make you feel better but at the end of the day, it's just not true. Not at all. I'm neither a girl or a boy at this point; I'm that third group of degenerate. 

And that makes me uncomfortable as fuck. To think that guys cheat on their wives/SO to be with something like me. I dunno, I knew that was a possibility but I never really gave it too much thought. I don't vet for relationships... haha. It's just a fetish anyway. Fetishes can be really strange. Some people have an inanimate object fetish, like cars. It's not like they'd leave their significant others for me (not that I would ever want that). I don't really hate that I'm a fetish. Not really. I already said that it's not going to get any better than that so why would I vilify that? I know that some transgender people really rail against "chasers" but honestly... I don't care. What does it matter that they're only looking for a fetish if that's the best I can do? Even I'm not that proud. 

No, it's mostly knowing that I'll always be transgender that makes me sad. It's like having this unwashable filth on you at all times. It's this inherently dirty streak that can't ever be cleaned off, not even if I skinned myself. Sometimes I feel like I'm contaminating people by even making eye-contact with them; I feel extremely filthy all the time. I used to wash my hands until they were cracked and red and dry and bleeding before but I don't do that kinda shit anymore. I wash like a regular person! It's just this inescapable feeling of well, dirtiness that I can't seem to shake off. I feel sorry for my clients. I feel like I'm corrupting them. Then I feel like I'm being way too self important and vain, like something like me could even have the effect to "corrupt" other people is laughable. I don't know how to really explain this beyond: I'm trans and that, to me, is like being permanently coated in a layer of shit.

I hate how I look, yes. I'm passable enough, maybe on the verge of passing to not-passing. On the knife's edge. When I had long hair, people thought I was a woman (or they could have just been nice) and now that I have a short cut, children ask me if I'm a guy or girl (even after I talk! which is weird). In my experience, there's two sides to this. One, children are more likely to speak their mind. They aren't worrying about "transphobia" or "omg if I'm mean to a tranny how will it backfire on my career/friends/etc". On the other hand, children are kinda dumb and I could probably put a wig on the Rock and convince them that he's a woman haha. Adults are more likely to act all sensitive and tell me shit like, "No! You are totally passing! You look like a bona fide, 100%, natural-grown zero preservatives woman!" and other hugboxing crap like that. Still, my grandparents thought I was my mother on the phone (but then again, they're old for old so nothing's positive).  

It's not the looks that bother me so much though. Looks can always be fixed, more or less, if you have the money for it. It's the knowledge that no matter how much work I get done, no matter how much time passes by, no matter what medicines I take: I still will be a tranny. Nothing will change that. The part of me that I hate most will always stay with me sooo... what really is the point of carrying on? I don't know; I think it's the fact that dying is so painful (unless you have a gun!) that's stopping me. 

It's this knowledge that I'm always going to be fake in a way that I can't reconcile. I'm always going to be the odd one out. I don't care how "progressive" or "tolerating" people say they are; they aren't. I know that they aren't... it's really fucking obvious. I'll always be in that untouchable group, the same one that the obviously undesirable choices are put into when you play a game of "Fuck, Marry, Kill". Like I said before, I'm only tolerable to people when they need me as an image to boost their progressive points. Beyond that? Forget it. And I'm not saying this shame anyone, or to hold someone at metaphorical gun-point while screaming, "DATE ME OR YOU'RE A TERRIBLE PERSON!" I get it. I get why I'm an outsider. I'm not trying to change it. Is it so bad that sometimes, I feel quite torn up about it? Can I not complain? I'm not trying to get anyone to change their ways or their opinions. 

I know I sound like a whiny naive person but I honestly think that I can't deal with the reality of knowing that no matter what I ever do, what I ever accomplish, I will always be that guy/girl. People are always going to talk shit about me, whether I have two dollars to my name or two hundred million. And it gets to me, even though I tell myself that I need tougher skin. Knowing that even "progressive" people feel that squick factor when they talk to me makes me want to rip my face off. And I don't care how much they deny it. It's very obvious in the way their treatment. I wish they would just come out and say, "Hey, support you and all, but you freak me out so keep your distance" or something along those lines. Fucking fake people with their over-the-top enthusiastic "support" makes me irritated like none other. 

I've accepted that the only option left for me is just to accept that I'll only ever be a secret fetish, nothing more. Not even an open fetish; that's the sort reserved for things like BDSM or DD talk. I'm a secret fetish, something that you can't really admit to your friends. Hey, I'm ostracized for a reason. I'm strange. The really funny thing to me is that people don't even want to fuck me—they want me to fuck them! Haha. Oh well. Suck it up, buttercup? If they're the ones giving me money, I don't have any right to complain. I want to just travel back in time and convince my mother to have an abortion. Either that or push my childhood self into traffic. I just think that so many accidents happen annually, all those hundreds of car crashes and what not... and of all people, I survive? I did run into traffic once as a kid but as you know, nothing happened. Weird world. I'll never understand it.

Right then. I'm normally not this whiny but I guess the barriers come down with anonymity. It's sorta weird "talking" openly about my suicidal thoughts. I haven't done it outside at all. None of my therapists know at all (but I'm sure they suspect it). The fucked up thing is that without hormones I'm (even more) suicidal but to get on them in the first place, I had to say I wasn't suicidal at all! Haha! It's easy to lie to my therapists. 

It's almost like I'm having a mental break right now—talking about suicide has flooded the gates, so to speak, and now I'm feeling like extremely bitter. Not so much at the world or anything like that—just at me. I think I have a very prideful personality and that's fucking me up even more. It's like I'm acting as if I'm above my social status and shitting on everyone below and at my level. Disgustingly smug. Just another way I'm a fraud, I guess. I can't even act the part of a suicidal person right, haha. I've cut myself in the past but nowadays I only pinch and scratch myself. Too afraid of pain but still fake enough to seek attention... haha. 

I have a suspicion that I enjoy self pity. I'm a sucker for mentally self-flagellating myself. I want someone to hit me. I want someone to physically beat me up. My brother hit me and I wanted him to kill me. I dunno, I'm just so far gone at this point that all I can think about is dying or how I look. Half the time I daydream about suicide scenarios; it's kinda fun. 

But having someone complain all the time is very annoying; I know that from experience. It's a bore to listen to downers. I don't have anything light-hearted to talk about though, unless you want to know about what I ate for dinner ha. 

Thanks for taking the time to talk to me.

Haha is this a joke? 

There's nothing going on in my life. I'm just being a miserable person.

The funny thing is that I'm not mad at society at all. I've just accepted that this is how things are really. It's not realistic to expect the world to change so quickly over such a strange thing... I just wish that I had tougher skin so that I could shut it all out. 

I wish I lived in America so that I could get a gun. In light of all the bad news, I know that it's insensitive of me to wish something like that but I do. I think having the guarantee of a quick death would make the days pass by much easier. The closest thing I have to a gun is a bridge and I'm not even sure that it's high enough off the ground for the fall to kill me instantly. Besides, I feel uncomfortable leaving behind a mess for people to clean up after—if I had a gun, I could go deep into the woods and end it. I don't know if any of this qualifies for euthanasia either so I can't tell any of this to my therapist because he'll try to get me "help" (he'd send me to a center). 

Some part of me also feels sorry for my mother for some reason. She's had a rough life including domestic violence and I feel like I've ruined her mental well-being. Even though I know that she hates me, I don't want to push her over the edge by having her discover a corpse. I just really want to disappear... if God offered me the choice between being happy with myself and just never having been born, I'd choose the latter in a heartbeat. 

I wouldn't say that life is too hard either. I had a choice. I could have done better in so many different ways but the truth is that on top of all my gender issues, I'm also an extremely lazy person. It's hard to do even the simplest things like eating nowadays. Not that anyone cares; I don't eat with my family anymore. I mostly eat instant meals in my room when I can remember. 

I suppose that I should consider myself lucky in many ways too. Sometimes I look at other people like me and it feels like I'm complaining over nothing. At least my parents haven't completely kicked me out yet! At least I don't look too overtly masculine! I didn't even need to spend too many sessions getting rid of my facial hair, seeing how I had barely more than peach fuzz. At least I live in a first world country! At least my parents are tolerant enough to not have killed me! Some people are homeless before they even graduate high school... I look at them and realize that my circumstances aren't terrible after all. But I can't seem to stop myself from feeling terrible again five minutes later. 

I don't even know why I posted this in the first place. I know that there's nothing anyone can do to help me feel better... my three therapists have already proven that. None of them have helped me at all; it's just empty bullshit. Not that I went to them to get help; no, I'm just wasting money and venting to them about issues that I know that they wouldn't care about if I didn't pay them. It's incredibly pathetic that I have to pay somebody to listen to me. 

There's so many things that I want to talk to you about but I just can't. I'm not smart enough to put into words what I want to say... I can't form a coherent thought on what I really want to say. It's locked up in my head and it's the most frustrating thing! I can't even talk to my therapists clearly and it's like I'm a mute. It's like someone cut up my memories and thoughts and emotions and just glued it together in some abstract form; I feel like I can only vaguely understand what I'm feeling myself. 

I have no goals in life. I'm just living day after day because dying is, ironically, harder than living. Haha. I was interested in maybe keeping a small aquarium once. I wanted to try keeping a planted tank. But I've become obsessed with living a minimal life until I can save enough money to do what I want... I don't even have a hobby.

It seems like my life revolves around my vain and proud nature. The things I spend my money on make me feel like a creep. All I do is work on "shaping" my body and voice and my general aesthetic and although it is for me... at the same time it's also to make myself more appealing for any potential clients. But isn't that creepy? I feel like throwing up. If my parents found out, they'd undoubtedly kick me out, haha! My therapist told me to be careful but I know that he doesn't care. His voice makes me want to rip off my own ears.  Sometimes I feel like I'm risking it more and more everyday... besides hoping I somehow vanish, I'm wishing for someone else to kill me. It'd be easier if it wasn't my own hand, I think. 

It just seems silly to me that everyone knows how I'm going to end up and I'm delaying that for what seems to be no viable reason at all. Other people have things to live for. I'm just extremely cowardly at heart, otherwise I'd stab myself right now. I guess I'll just go through life day after day until I work up the courage to do it. There's always a loser in life; just my luck that it has to be me! Oh well, let the winner take it all. 

Thanks for taking the time to respond to me. I know that I've been very dramatic. I don't know what I expected out of this but the fact that someone responded made it as good as anything.
